item.title: 【Helpdesk】[TUTORIAL] How to properly play a 25fps PAL Interlaced smoothly
item.description:
This tutorial is for who has problems by playing interlaced videos 25fps PAL (Those .vob files from old DVDs)
For MacOS users I recommend Movist Pro or IINA players
For Windows users I recommend PotPlayer (its way better than VLC, MPC, KMPlayer,...)

If you don't have any "interlaced 25fps PAL" to test, I'll let a download link below for a music video
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
Ok, now play the video and check if its very smooth... If it's a "Yes" you can close this tutorial ♥

So you are feeling that is not that smooth as it should be, let's fix this!

Open PotPlayer app and press F5 (Preferences)
Go to Filter Control > Video Decoder > Built-in Video Codec/DXVA Settings


Be sure to enable "Use DXVA" and "Prioritize D3D11 DXVA"
Also on DXVA2 Copy-Back select "D3D11: **your GPU card**"

Apply! Now go back to the Preferences page again (F5)

Go to "Video" preferences, and on "Video Output Settings"
Choose Video Render: Built-in Direct 3D 11 Video Renderer

Apply! OK! Now those video should play smoothly as it should be
